The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c9fde2b758f25505), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Choose the abelian data and the pencil dt = d0 + td1 in the generic sets of Lemma 4.5. There is a nonempty algebraic open O ⊂ A1 t and a smooth projective family of K3 surfaces S0 → O with a flat isometric embedding of rational Hodge variations U ,→ R2 (S0 /O)∗Q. The form on U here is its cup-product form inherited from Y . For very general t, this summand is the transcendental part of H2(S0 t , Q). For every s in a nonempty Zariski-open subset of A1 s, every smooth projective model of the total family obtained by t = s + u2 is uniruled. The K3 family over O is defined over the original t-line; an additional unspecified finite base change is not part of the conclusion.
